metadata.question: Does Cambodia have more active fire detections in February 2018 compared to August 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS/MODIS active fire product (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or MODIS/061/MOD14A1) - Date ranges: February 2018 (2018-02-01 to 2018-02-28) vs August 2017 (2017-08-01 to 2017-08-31) - Location: Cambodia country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - Fire products have confidence bands - filter for high confidence fires - Use FireMask or MaxFRP bands to identify actual fire detections 3. Logic: - Count total fire pixels for each period - Compare: Feb 2018 > Aug 2017 → A, otherwise → B - Handle cases: no data (C1), no fires detected but images exist (valid zero = B), calculation error (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Cambodia geometry const cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')) .geometry(); // 2. Load MODIS Active Fire product const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1'); // 3. Filter for two periods const aug2017 = fireCollection .filterDate('2017-08-01', '2017-08-31') .filterBounds(cambodia); const feb2018 = fireCollection .filterDate('2018-02-01', '2018-02-28') .filterBounds(cambodia); // 4. Check collection sizes const aug2017Size = aug2017.size().getInfo(); const feb2018Size = feb2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 2017 Images: ${aug2017Size}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 Images: ${feb2018Size}`); if (aug2017Size === 0 || feb2018Size === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Count fire detections using FireMask band (values 7-9 indicate fires) const countFires = (collection, geometry) => { const fireMask = collection.select('FireMask').map(img => img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)) ); const totalFires = fireMask.sum(); const result = totalFires.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return result.get('FireMask').getInfo(); }; // 6. Calculate fire counts const aug2017Fires = countFires(aug2017, cambodia); const feb2018Fires = countFires(feb2018, cambodia); console.log(`Aug 2017 Fire Detections: ${aug2017Fires}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 Fire Detections: ${feb2018Fires}`); // 7. Validate results if (aug2017Fires === null || feb2018Fires === null || isNaN(aug2017Fires) || isNaN(feb2018Fires)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and answer if (feb2018Fires > aug2017Fires) { console.log('Feb 2018 has more fire detections than Aug 2017.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Feb 2018 does not have more fire detections than Aug 2017.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
